description: BODC publishes historical sea-level observations recovered from Alicante’s inner and outer harbours by the University of the Balearic Islands research team. Seven outer-harbour records and five inner-harbour records were digitised, checked and joined using instrument and levelling information. The published period runs from July 1870 to December 2018, with daily averages before the 1920s and hourly observations thereafter. Text data and documentation are available without access restrictions, and repository-supplied metadata state CC-BY-4.0. The series can test coastal water-level simulations and provide a historical baseline for port and flood-defence exposure analysis. It complements recent tide gauges with rescued observations from earlier instruments. The describing article cautions that long-term datum reliability is not fully resolved, especially for Alicante I. Daily averages also miss short surge peaks. Trend and extreme-value studies therefore require attention to instrument transitions, temporal aggregation and datum uncertainty, not treating the combined series as uniformly observed.
